name: Forgotten Mines
description: An abandoned mine shaft where glittering crystals hide dark shadows. Highly volatile elemental creatures dwell in its deepest reaches.
visualTheme: Decaying wooden support beams and rusted mine-cart tracks descending into pitching black mine shafts.

history.createdWhy: Dug by the Iron Clan dwarfs to extract gold and silver ore.
history.builtWho: The Dwarf Kings of the Black Mountains.
history.majorEvents: Abandoned overnight when miners broke into a nest of subterranean elemental serpents.
history.whyExists: Now serves as a breeding ground for mineral-fed monsters.
history.currentConflicts: Bandits are using the upper levels to store stolen military shipments.
